title: Cover Story
description: Explain an impossible public incident, decode the private motives behind suspicious alibis, and crown the room's favorite cover story.

presentationMetadata.shortDescription: Write a suspicious alibi, decode hidden motives, and crown the room's favorite cover story.
presentationMetadata.longDescription: An impossible incident just crashed into a live comic broadcast. Every player gets a secret motive and writes an anonymous one-sentence cover story. Decode another player's motive, crown the best excuse, and score for favorite covers, correct deductions, and lies that get successfully decoded. Three fast cases end with a winner reveal and ridiculous superlatives.
